intro: Kyle's Gone Missing! is a local quest in Bloodhoof Village where Ahab Wheathoof asks passing adventurers to find his wayward dog, Kyle the Frenzied. Feeding the hungry pup a cut of tender strider meat soothes his temper and ensures his safe return home.

p: In Bloodhoof Village, elder Ahab Wheathoof worries over his wayward pet, Kyle the Frenzied. While the title might sound alarming to outsiders, Kyle is Ahab's prized puppy who has slipped away onto the grassy plains of Mulgore. Ahab asks travelers passing through the settlement to track down his unruly companion and offer him a hearty meal to calm his wild spirits.

Pacifying Kyle requires a cut of tender strider meat, sourced from the swift plainstriders that roam Mulgore. Presenting the treat satisfies the hungry pup, soothing his frenzied mood and nudging him safely back toward Bloodhoof Village and his grateful owner.
